items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states the class of ind-quasi-affine morphisms of schemes is stable under composition. The retained proof is written from the chapter's alternative-definition dictionary (collected this wave as L16109): given f : X -> Y and g : Y -> Z ind-quasi-affine, take a qcqs open V in Z and a quasi-compact open U of the total inverse image; the image f(U) is quasi-compact inside g^{-1}(V) so it sits in a quasi-compact open W (a union of finitely many affines); W -> V is quasi-affine by the dictionary, making W quasi-separated; applying the dictionary again to U inside the inverse image over W gives U -> W quasi-affine; the composition of quasi-affine morphisms (Morphisms, lemma composition-quasi-affine) yields U -> V quasi-affine; the dictionary's criterion closes the proof. Retained author proof at lines 19589-19603.
